renders_to: claude.ai artifact (a RENDER of this file; this JSON is the source of truth). Generated by docs/board/render-board.mjs into docs/board/<board>.rendered.html, which is a build product and gitignored; never hand-edited.
doctrine: A board claim is never truth on its own. The evidence field carries the proof. The executor terminal updates this JSON at every checkpoint and re-renders. A card may not enter status=shipped with evidence=null; a launch gate condition may not be state=pass with evidence=null. Enforced by docs/board/validate-board.mjs. GATE VOCABULARY: state what each value of the card `gate` field means for THIS project, because the enum is fixed and its words are read literally.

lanes.title: LAUNCH GATE
lanes.note: The launch-readiness conditions, each pass or fail, nothing else. Readiness = passed / denominator, counted never estimated.

lanes.title: BLOCKED ON PEOPLE
lanes.note: One column per person who can owe an answer. THESE IDS ARE THE ALLOWED VALUES OF card.blocked_on - the validator reads them from here. Answer latency = now - last_checkpoint, made visible.

lanes.title: STAKEHOLDER FEEDBACK
lanes.note: The inbox lane. THE LANE ID IS FIXED AS `rodica_batch` and cannot be renamed - the validator and the board app both pin the exact lane-id set. Change only the title.

lanes.title: SHIPPED
lanes.note: Collapsed by default, count only, expandable.

cards.title: One-line scope: what is true when this card is done, stated as an outcome rather than a task.

evidence.ref: PR number, merge sha, file path, or command output - written so a stranger can re-verify it without asking anyone.

cards.notes: The card's own record: what was decided and WHY, what was tried, what is deliberately not being done. This field is where the reasoning lives, so a fresh reader needs no chat history.
cards.open_on_purpose: OPTIONAL. Present only on a card that stays open after its evidence exists - e.g. the build merged but an owner still has to observe it on a screen. The reconciler prints every one of these in full on every run, so an exemption nobody sees is an exemption nobody revisits. Delete this field on an ordinary card.
